policy.claim_limit: Selection makes no winner, replication or utility-benefit claim. Intervals describe the frozen preselection contrasts; the largest point estimate may be noise. Native can remain competitive even when an action is selected. Online timing and reader costs require separate qualification and utility evaluation.

family_selection: First N frozen utility families, chosen before pilot outcomes; all two-arm/two-seed cells retained.
episode_rule: One first two-reader-accepted episode; no re-entry; no side-query count cap.

side_work_hard_bound.practical_limit: None; every lexical opportunity before first acceptance is screened.

reuse_rule: Pilot assignments retain frozen utility UIDs and may enter final ITT only when policy, sampler, source, controller, and execution profile remain exactly unchanged.
